exposure: presence of separate staff for newborn
postnatal contact of mother or newborn with health care providers within one hour after delivery
cohort: 249 mothers with normal vaginal deliveries at 15 public health facilities in 3 districts in Bangladesh.
finding: Initiation of breastfeeding within one hour of birth was significantly associated with delivery at district hospitals, visual privacy in the delivery room, spontaneous breathing of newborns, skin-to-skin contact, and postnatal contact with healthcare providers.
